title: Do not call the fever your personality
summary: Ego may feel like personality, but the shabad calls it disease and wandering. Freedom starts when the fever of selfhood is refused as the deepest truth about you.
takeaway: Do not mistake the fever for your real name.
lifeApplication: Before defending your image, pause long enough to feel the fever underneath it. Let the Guru's medicine make you smaller, truer, and less afraid of being corrected.

source.shortMeaning: Ego feels intimate, but the shabad names it as disease and wandering rather than the soul's real identity.
source.lifeApplication: Before defending yourself, ask whether the self being protected is the illness or the truth.

evidence.turn: Refuse to let the fever of selfhood tell you who you are.
